tasks.subject: Task 1: Star cutoff math + unit tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `star_cutoffs(path)` returns the chart's base score, its solo bonus, and the seven cutoffs, computed the way Clone Hero does. `Path::avg_mult()` reads the same base score.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/core/stars.h`
- Create: `src/core/stars.cpp`
- Modify: `src/core/model.h` (declare `chart_base_score()` next to `avg_mult()`, around line 444)
- Modify: `src/core/model.cpp` (define it just above `Path::avg_mult()`, around line 594, and make `avg_mult()` call it)
- Modify: `CMakeLists.txt` (add `src/core/stars.cpp` after `src/core/squeeze_rating.cpp` in `hydra_core`, and `tests/test_stars.cpp` after `tests/test_squeeze_rating.cpp` in `hydra_tests`)
- Test: `tests/test_stars.cpp`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `kStarMultipliers` is `{0.1f, 0.5f, 1.0f, 2.0f, 2.8f, 3.6f, 4.4f}`, and `kMaxStars == 7`.
- [ ] A base of 100,000 gives cutoffs 10,000 / 50,000 / 100,000 / 200,000 / 280,000 / 360,000 / 440,000.
- [ ] A base of 123,456 gives 12,346 / 61,728 / 123,456 / 246,912 / 345,677 / 444,442 / 543,207, so each is rounded up.
- [ ] A base of 786,437 gives a 6-star cutoff of 2,831,173 (the game's float result), not 2,831,174.
- [ ] A base of 0 gives seven zeros.
- [ ] A `Path` with `score_base` 1000, `score_ghosts` 100, `score_accents` 200 and `score_solo` 800 gives `chart_base_score() == 1300`, and `star_cutoffs` returns base 1300, solo bonus 800, and cutoffs 130 / 650 / 1300 / 2600 / 3640 / 4680 / 5720.
- [ ] `avg_mult()` returns the same values as before. The existing `test_model.cpp` and `test_path_view.cpp` cases still pass unchanged.
- [ ] The whole `hydra_tests` suite reports `Status: SUCCESS!`.

**Verify:** `.\build_cpp.ps1 -Target hydra_tests; .\build-cpp\Release\hydra_tests.exe -tc="stars*"` → `Status: SUCCESS!`, then `.\build-cpp\Release\hydra_tests.exe` → `Status: SUCCESS!`

The full test code and module code are in the plan's Task 1 steps. Copy them as written.


tasks.subject: Task 2: Stars tab + GUI test
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A `Stars` tab after `Dynamics` shows the base score, the solo bonus (only when there is one), and the seven cutoffs, all from `star_cutoffs(record->best_path())`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/ui/details_view.cpp` (include `core/stars.h`, add `render_stars_panel` after `render_dynamics_panel`, add the tab item after the Dynamics tab item around line 1245)
- Modify: `tests/ui/uitest_tests.cpp` (include `core/stars.h`, add `open_titled`, `analyze_open_song` and `test_stars` after `test_dynamics_stored`, and register `{"stars", test_stars}`)
- Modify: `docs/agents/ui-testing.md` (the Song Details line of the label cheat-sheet)
- Modify: `CONTEXT.md` (a "Star cutoff" entry after "Multiplier squeeze")

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The tab bar reads Paths, Preview, Dynamics, Stars, in that order.
- [ ] Before analysis, the Stars tab shows `After analyzing this song, star cutoffs will show up here.`
- [ ] After analyzing "87" (Polyphia, which has an Expert drums solo), the tab shows `Base score: `, the solo bonus line, the `With full solo bonus` header, every cutoff, and 7-star cutoff + solo bonus, all matching `star_cutoffs(best_path())` through `group_thousands`.
- [ ] After analyzing "I'm A Believer (The Monkees cover)", whose only solo is on guitar, the solo bonus is 0. The tab shows the base score and cutoffs, but no `Solo bonus` line and no `With full solo bonus` column.
- [ ] `hydra_uitest --all` reports every test `[PASS]`, and `hydra_tests` still reports `Status: SUCCESS!`.

**Verify:** `.\build_cpp.ps1 -Target hydra_uitest; .\build-cpp\Release\hydra_uitest.exe --test stars` → `[PASS] stars`, then `.\build-cpp\Release\hydra_uitest.exe --all` → every test `[PASS]`

The full UI code, test code, and exact text strings are in the plan's Task 2 steps and Global Constraints. Copy them as written.
